seo.title: Protect a PDF with a Password — Free & Secure | JPdf
seo.description: Add a password to a PDF so only people who know it can open it. Free, fast, and private.

subtitle: Add a password so only people who know it can open this PDF.

howItWorks.title: How to password-protect a PDF
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to protect.
Click Protect PDF and download the result.

items.a: Yes, protecting a PDF is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will I need this password to open the file later?
items.a: Yes. Keep it safe — if you lose it, the file can't be opened without it.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
